name: Two deliberate reuses for practical store and service information

entries.name: Find useful arrival information
entries.visitor_need: Find step-free access and arrival information before planning a visit.
entries.difference: Reuse Availability note for two factual arrival-information groups and one details link. Different information is a use case, not another design.
acceptance: Use verified venue information and a working access page.
If details are unknown, direct visitors to an enquiry; do not assert that the venue is accessible.
Compare the filled first screen with both named existing designs; reject a palette-only or copy-only difference.
Inspect every screen and result at 320/390/768/1440px, RTL, longer text and missing optional artwork.
Walk choose, customise, configure, preview and local publication in real WordPress. Check dismissal, validation, failure/retry and real destination links. No CI or external delivery.

entries.name: Read the current returns policy
entries.visitor_need: Find the applicable returns policy while browsing a seasonal collection.
entries.difference: Reuse Inline signpost for a short policy notice with one link. No new bar for a different message.
acceptance: Use actual policy terms and the correct destination; no countdown or fixed deadline without a real schedule.
Keep the message shallow, dismissible and readable on phones.
